## Episode Thesis

Episode 473 covers a steep week for US mega-cap tech. Nasdaq 100 is 10% off its peak and 21 of its members are in bear territory after weak reports from Alphabet, Amazon, Intel, ServiceNow and Reddit. Microsoft was the one bright spot. The hosts point to free cash flow turning negative under huge AI capex, and to how quickly market narratives change. They also cover Anthropic's S-1 ahead of its IPO, the US midterms, central bank decisions (an expected Riksbank hike to 2%), savings accounts versus fixed-income funds, how to use watchlists, and Avanza's October fund flows. Customers bought back into tech and North America funds and sold fixed-income, small-cap, precious-metal and defense funds.
